thread:
Ava - Growth: Quick kickoff — we need a tight narrative for the performance economics piece (response time vs $/1M tokens). audience: product folks and infra leads. goal: 1-pager + chart for launch post + webinar slide.
Ben - Content: Agree. Leaning toward a single clear claim: "sub-second median with X$/1M tokens". need a headline number.
Priya (PM): Can we make two variants: one that emphasizes latency (for consumer UX teams) and one that emphasizes cost (for infra/finance)?
Liam - Research: We have cluster-level results: hosted baseline median latency 420ms at 1k tokens; optimized routing + batching median 210ms. cost: hosted $12/1M tokens vs optimized $4/1M tokens (quantized + cache). that's ~3x cost reduction.
Sam - Data: I'll pull a small table for the slide. rough axes suggestion: x = median latency (ms), y = $/1M tokens, point size = throughput (tokens/s).
Ava - Growth: Nice. Can we show a clear tradeoff curve instead of two disconnected points? show path: hosted -> batching -> quantize+cache -> dedicated. visual should show both latency drop and cost drop.
Ben - Content: For the post copy: "From 420ms to 210ms median latency while lowering token spend by 3x — giving product teams the fast, affordable inference they need." short, but we can A/B headline alternatives.
Priya (PM): CTA options: sign up for demo, request Dedicated trial, or register for a deeper webinar. Which do we prioritize for the campaign?
Ava - Growth: Webinar first, then demo signups. Webinar CTA should be framed as "See how teams cut latency & spend".
Liam - Research: Chart notes for design team (can paste to figma):
```
chart_type: scatter + path
points:
  hosted: {latency:420, cost:12, throughput: 120}
  batching: {latency:310, cost:8, throughput: 180}
  quantize_cache: {latency:210, cost:4, throughput: 250}
  dedicated: {latency:180, cost:3.5, throughput: 800}
x_axis: median response time (ms)
y_axis: $ per 1M tokens
annotation: use arrows/labels to show upgrade path; highlight ~3x cost reduction callout
```
Sam - Data: I'll validate those numbers and attach the CSV. expect small variance by model size; these are for the 7B family test set.
Ben - Content: For the blog, include a short one-paragraph methodology note: what model, sequence lengths, and how caching was measured. keep it 2-3 sentences.
Ava - Growth: Messaging framing idea: "Better inference doesn't have to cost more." subline: "Reduce median response time and token spend with smart serving — hosted, dedicated, or private."
Priya (PM): Also include risk section: quality parity checks after quantization + fallback policy notes. we don't want people to think it's just lossy compression.
Liam - Research: Agreed — include eval summary: automated evals + small human spot checks; no significant regression on our standard prompt suite.
Ben - Content: Draft hero copy for slide: "3x lower token cost and Sub-250ms median latency — keep UX snappy without breaking the budget." shorter alt: "Fast. Cheap. Reliable inference."
Ava - Growth: Ok next actions: Sam to upload CSV by EOD, Liam to paste a figma-ready chart spec, Ben to draft two headlines, Priya to prepare the brief for webinar flow. I'll assemble the 1-pager. @marcom-bot can you schedule a design sync tomorrow 10am PT? :calendar: 
marcom-bot: Design sync scheduled for 2026-04-22 17:00 UTC. Invite sent to participants.
Ben - Content: One last thought — include an inline micro-case: "A checkout flow reduced latency from 600ms to 220ms, conversion lifted +1.8%" if we can anonymize. good hook for product folks.
Priya (PM): We have that metric from the pilot — Sam please confirm anonymization and stat.
Sam - Data: Confirmed — anonymized conversion delta ok to use. I'll attach the sanitized chart.
Ava - Growth: Perfect. I'll start the landing copy and share drafts in this thread. :rocket:
